title: Dry Bulk's Hydropower & Coal Mining Saviors in China
section_path: Dry Bulk's Hydropower & Coal Mining Saviors in China
section_path_text: Dry Bulk's Hydropower & Coal Mining Saviors in China
summary:
Main
By Jeffrey Landsberg
As we discussed in Commodore Research's most recent Weekly Executive Report, China's coal production totaled 385.1 million tons in September. This is up month-on-month by 23.3 million tons (6%) but down year-on-year by 26.4 million tons (-6%). Remaining very significant is that the last time that there was any year-on-year growth was back in June 2025.
